additional_info.subject: Issue description
additional_info.body:
At the charging station, we received, among others, the error
"ERR_EV_DROPPED, vehicle ended with unexpected pilot state B".
Since we have seen this multiple times at other stations, a more
detailed analysis would be desirable here as well. I can't imagine
that the vehicle is causing problems when it usually works at other
stations with the same vehicle.

additional_info.subject: ID0455721-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP / T9 170005102] ERR_EV_Dropped CRM:02698000613
additional_info.body:
Hello Johannes,
As we previously checked together, the PreCharge voltage is not raising completely to the TargetVoltage.
We need to check:
Check the 2...10V output signal to see if it matches the real voltage.
I recommend you to take a spare QA21-22 and TF1.
My honest opinion is that it should be QA21-22 that is not fully closing. I recommend starting directly checking the voltage on the busbars, it is mandatory to use crocodile tips to measure this.
Best regards,
Francisco
